Agent 22/35 — ABS during steering + braking. Run braking-in-turn cases at 60/90/120 km/h with ABS SPORT/FULL/OFF, logging pressure, slip, Fx/Fy utilization, yaw and trajectory. Check whether ABS target/slip logic maintains steerability rather than forcing excessive straight-line bias. Do not tune brake bias or tire grip without evidence. Add deterministic mirrored combined-braking tests for any fix.
